subject: AuroraFin - MAP: Security gate milestones & close timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aurorafin.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: AuroraFin - MAP: security gate milestones & close timeline

Ethan —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that separates the commercial milestones from the security/compliance gates so legal & security teams can run in parallel. Key security gates included: SOC 2 Type II evidence, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire completion, executed DPA with the retention appendix, and EU/US data residency alignment for production data.

High-level timeline proposed:
- Dec 15: MAP + intake (this email) — confirmation of reviewers
- Jan 4–14: Evidence collection + SIG questionnaire turnaround
- Jan 15–21: Technical staging / canary evaluation (short window)
- Jan 22–28: Legal review & DPA sign-off
- Target close: Jan 28 (contract executed + security acceptance)

Please confirm: 1) who on AuroraFin legal will own DPA redlines, 2) whether you require EU-only residency (we have region options), and 3) whether the SIG should be returned as completed CAIQ or with supporting evidence links.

Attached: AuroraFin-MAP-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, 412KB) — draft MAP with milestone owner columns.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Ethan Lowe <ethan@aurorafin.com>

Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AuroraFin - MAP: security gate milestones & close timeline

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick notes from our side:
1) Legal owner for the DPA will be Priya Shah (cc’ed). Priya — we typically turn redlines around in ~5 business days; will confirm by EOD Monday.
2) EU residency: our primary concern is customer PII for EU customers. We need confirmation that production data for EU tenants can be restricted to eu-central-1 or equivalent. Can you confirm any technical limitations for the canary?
3) SOC 2: we require the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or a SOC 2 readout + remediation plan if still in progress). If Redwood can provide the report or a secure share link, that helps speed internal signoff.

Attaching our intake worksheet with a few items flagged (data residency and retention windows).

attachment: aurorafin-legal-questions.xlsx (XLSX, 66KB)

Thanks — will route to our InfoSec for the SIG/CAIQ.

—Ethan
Head of Product Partnerships, AuroraFin
ethan@aurorafin.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ethan Lowe <ethan@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 14:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AuroraFin - MAP: security gate milestones & close timeline

Ethan / Marcus —

Putting some specifics on the record from infra/security:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for our control environment; I can provide a secure ShareFile link to the report and a short SOC2-summary.pdf (attached) by Dec 23. If you need an in-person evidence review, we can book a 30-minute walkthrough with our security lead.
- Data residency: we support region pinning for production datasets. For the canary/staging window you mentioned (Jan 15–21), we recommend running the canary in us-west-2 for low-latency, and a mirrored eu-central-1 config if you want to validate EU residency constraints. There is a small ops lead-time (~72 hours) to provision the mirrored environment.
- DPA: we are generally comfortable with standard market redlines; please send Priya’s redlines and we’ll aim for a 3–5 business day turnaround.
- Retention: Attached is a proposed retention appendix outline (see SOC2-summary.pdf section 3). Our default retention tiers are 30 / 90 / 365 days for cached tokens/logs depending on contract tier; we can propose an EU-only retention lane if required.

Proposed adjustment to the MAP schedule to set realistic work windows across holidays:
- Jan 4–18: evidence collection & SIG completion (longer window to account for reviewers)
- Jan 19–25: canary & technical verification
- Jan 26–Feb 1: legal review & signatures
- Target close: Feb 1 (contract + security acceptance)

I’ll add these notes to the MAP and upload an updated security gates appendix.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF, 224KB)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aurorafin.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AuroraFin - MAP: security gate milestones & close timeline

Ethan / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the intake sheet — super helpful. I’ve consolidated Kim’s guidance and your asks into an updated MAP and security appendix attached (redwood-map-security-gates-v2.pdf). Highlights and asks:

1) Evidence delivery: we will provide a secure SOC 2 Type II share link (final report) and a short evidence checklist. Please confirm InfoSec reviewer names and preferred method for receiving evidence (secure link vs. SFTP).

2) SIG/CAIQ: We will return the CAIQ with in-line evidence links. If AuroraFin prefers a completed CAIQ without links, let us know, but inline links expedite verification.

3) DPA & retention appendix: Priya — please upload redlines to the DocuSign/Collaborate link below. We added an EU-only retention lane in the appendix (90 days for tokens, 365 days for audit logs), but can adjust.

4) Final timeline proposal (updated):
- Jan 4–18: Evidence collection & SIG completion (owners: Redwood security + AuroraFin InfoSec)
- Jan 19–25: Canary run (eu-central-1 mirror available if you confirm by Jan 8)
- Jan 26–Feb 1: Legal redlines & signature window
- Target contract execute + security acceptance: Feb 1 (we can accelerate to Jan 28 if DPA redlines are minimal)

Next actions:
- Priya: drop DPA redlines to the DocuSign Collaborate link by Jan 6
- Ethan: confirm InfoSec reviewer and whether you want completed CAIQ or CAIQ+evidence links by Jan 6
- Marcus/Kim: schedule a 30-min evidence walkthrough for the week of Jan 11 (I'll send a calendar invite once reviewers are confirmed)
